General
* This seems too easy as a puzzle. Please re-create the contribution as a clash of code.

Formatting
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly by following the example there (e.g. variables [[N]] and [[M]], constant {{IMPOSSIBLE}}, line numbers in bold <<Line 1>>).

Constraints
* Please use upper bounds that are closer to the values used in the actual cases.

Cases
* Every test and its corresponding validator should cover the same scenario, but with slightly different inputs and outputs (except in the case of IMPOSSIBLE).

Thanks.
